reasoning: The test image shows a tomato leaf with yellowing and numerous small dark spots/specks scattered across the leaf surface, along with some larger necrotic lesions near the edges. This pattern of small dark specks on a yellowing leaf is characteristic of Bacterial Speck of Tomato (Pseudomonas syringae pv. tomato).
